quantityRules.note: salt to taste — doubled servings don't double the salt
eggs don't half-count — rounded to whole

timeRules.appliesWhen: pan-fried meat or fish thicker than 2 cm
timeRules.copy: A thicker piece needs up to a few minutes more — check the middle, don't trust the timer.

timeRules.appliesWhen: pan more than 2 sizes off the recipe
timeRules.copy: A smaller pan holds more depth, so check earlier than the timer says.
